sources.title: Cloudflare has introduced an AI model called Clef, a competitor to Jev ...
sources.snippet: Cloudflare has introduced two new AI models, Clef and Clef-flash, which are designed to quickly make specific decisions: answer "yes" or "no", choose one of the options, or prioritize them. The company positions them as a competitor to the Jev model from TypeSafe AI.

sources.snippet: Cloudflare's Clef-omni is a 30B-A3B open-weight decision model that scores audio, video, image and text in one call.

sources.snippet: We are introducing Clef and Clef-flash, open-source decision models hosted on Workers AI for high-speed classification and agentic workflows. Also launching: a new reinforcement learning platform that allows developers to fine-tune decision models using their own data.
